resolution_notes: base_url: corrected. Verifier B was right that hardcoding /v71 is fragile. Official Checkout docs (docs.adyen.com) and API Explorer still document https://checkout-test.adyen.com as the test host and version the path (currently /v71 in examples); live hosts are company-prefix + region (e.g. https://{PREFIX}-checkout-live.adyenpayments.com). Directory base_url should be the stable test host root without a pinned major version so it does not go stale when Adyen ships v72+. Evidence: https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/Checkout/latest/overview , https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/live-endpoints , https://docs.adyen.com/online-payments/ .
